# app-config

kumiko.config.ts with defineAppConfig: the one feature list, client entries and ports the tooling reads.

## README

# App config

`kumiko.config.ts` is the one place an app names its features, client entries
and ports. `kumiko/schema.ts`, `kumiko agent lint`, `kumiko check` and
`kumiko ports` all read it.

## What it shows

- **`defineAppConfig`** from `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/config` validates the
  config when the file loads: ports in range and unique within the app, client
  entries relative and inside the app.
- **`prodFeatures`** are mounted only in production (provider features such as
  S3 or SMTP). `allAppFeatures(config)` returns `features` plus `prodFeatures`;
  that is the list migrations and agent lint check.
- **`ports`** with `dev`, `e2e` and optional `infra` (`postgres`, `redis`,
  `meilisearch`, `s3`). Keep them number literals: `kumiko ports` reads them
  statically across all apps of a workspace and reports collisions.

## Files

```
kumiko.config.ts                  defineAppConfig with features, prodFeatures, client, ports
src/feature.ts                    two placeholder features
src/__tests__/app-config.test.ts  feature list, port list, validation errors
```

See [`docs/reference/app-skeleton.md`](../../../docs/reference/app-skeleton.md)
for the files around it.

## Source files

### src/__tests__/app-config.test.ts

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import {
  allAppFeatures,
  defineAppConfig,
  findAppPortProblems,
  listAppPorts,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/config";
import appConfig from "../../kumiko.config";
import { notesFeature } from "../feature";

describe("kumiko.config.ts", () => {
  test("schema, agent lint and boot see features plus prodFeatures", () => {
    expect(allAppFeatures(appConfig).map((feature) => feature.name)).toEqual([
      "notes",
      "audit-export",
    ]);
  });

  test("ports list every claim, infrastructure included", () => {
    expect(listAppPorts(appConfig.ports)).toEqual([
      { role: "dev", port: 4510 },
      { role: "e2e", port: 4511 },
      { role: "postgres", port: 15510 },
    ]);
  });

  test("defineAppConfig rejects a port claimed twice inside the app", () => {
    const ports = { dev: 4510, e2e: 4510 };
    expect(findAppPortProblems(ports)).not.toEqual([]);
    expect(() =>
      defineAppConfig({ features: [notesFeature], client: { entries: ["src/client.tsx"] }, ports }),
    ).toThrow();
  });

  test("client entries must stay inside the app", () => {
    expect(() =>
      defineAppConfig({
        features: [notesFeature],
        client: { entries: ["../other-app/src/client.tsx"] },
        ports: { dev: 4510, e2e: 4511 },
      }),
    ).toThrow();
  });
});
```

### src/feature.ts

```ts
import { defineFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";

export const notesFeature = defineFeature("notes", () => {});

// Stands in for a provider feature that only production mounts (S3, SMTP).
export const auditExportFeature = defineFeature("audit-export", () => {});
```
